errors.text: The generated material description assigns all three transitions, including the approximately 214 K transition, to the fcc phase, whereas the target attributes the 214 K transition to the C14 phase.

Antiferromagnetic coupling is framed mainly as interfacial coupling between the fcc transition-metal matrix and a Ti-rich C14 phase, rather than coupling between Fe/Co/Ni and Ti sublattices that modifies the magnetic state associated with the fcc phase.
The proposed comparison measures only 400 K hysteresis and therefore cannot isolate the phase-specific 214 K, 168 K, and high-temperature transitions as requested.
